newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Askari Leasing up 4.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Askari Leasing up 4.64 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Askari Leasing gained 0.65 rupees, or 4.64 percent, to 14.65 on Monday on hopes of good annual results, dealers said.
Askari Leasing, whose financial year ends in June, was due to hold a board meeting later on Monday.
Some 8,500 shares of the stock changed hands at the Karachi bourse in early trade.
"Askari Leasing has done good business this year and people expect handsome profits," dealer Sajjad Mankani of BMA Capital Management said.
